instruction.name: vldrepl.d
instruction.description: Read 64-bit data from memory address `addr + offset`, replicate the data to all vector lanes and save into `dst`. Address misalignment does not raise an exception. The `offset` operand is a byte offset, matching the assembly immediate; the encoded instruction stores it as a scaled immediate for wider elements.

experiments.name: dependent chain
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 6666 --iters 300 --warmup 10 --reps 9 --core 0 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -2048; li.d $r22, -64; and $r20, $r20, $r22; st.d $r0, $r20, 0; st.d $r0, $r20, 8' --asm 'vldrepl.d $vr0, $r20, 0; vpickve2gr.d $r4, $vr0, 0; add.d $r20, $r20, $r4'

latencies.notes: rj -> vd. Chain: vldrepl.d reading at the carried base, then vpickve2gr.d (4 cycles) and add.d (1 cycle) to advance the base; the 5-cycle closure is subtracted. L1D hit. Three independent runs, raw cycle spread 9.92-10.00. Measured on 2026-11-17 on LA464, core 0.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vldrepl.d $vr0, $r20, 0; vldrepl.d $vr1, $r20, 8; vldrepl.d $vr2, $r20, 16; vldrepl.d $vr3, $r20, 24; vldrepl.d $vr4, $r20, 32; vldrepl.d $vr5, $r20, 40; vldrepl.d $vr6, $r20, 48; vldrepl.d $vr7, $r20, 56
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; li.d $r4, -64; and $r20, $r20, $r4' --asm 'vldrepl.d $vr0, $r20, 0; vldrepl.d $vr1, $r20, 8; vldrepl.d $vr2, $r20, 16; vldrepl.d $vr3, $r20, 24; vldrepl.d $vr4, $r20, 32; vldrepl.d $vr5, $r20, 40; vldrepl.d $vr6, $r20, 48; vldrepl.d $vr7, $r20, 56'

notes: No destination data dependency; latency is not defined. Throughput only. Re-derived with the two-cycle cross-domain calibration: movfr2gr and movgr2fr are 2 cycles each, movgr2frh.w is 3, the flag pair is 7/15, vpickve2gr is 3, xvpickve2gr is 5, and vreplgr2vr/xvreplgr2vr are 2 (3 for the byte and half-word broadcast).
